records.source: Oh, wow! A palace constructed for the sole purpose of entertainment!
records.translation: Oh, wow! Isang palasyong itinayo para lamang sa libangan!

records.source: Dwarf seems to be in a deep trance...
records.translation: Tila lubos na nabighani ang Duwende...

records.source: I didn't understand a thing, but the flashing lights were mesmerizing!
records.translation: Wala akong naintindihan, pero nakabibighani ang mga kumikislap na ilaw!

records.source: I know I'm going to love this movie! It was really nice of you to invite me, @.$h
records.translation: Alam kong magugustuhan ko ang pelikulang ito! Napakabait mo at inimbitahan mo ako, @.$h

records.source: Oh, I'm so glad the family was alright in the end. And the cows, too!$h
records.translation: Oh, natutuwa akong ligtas ang pamilya sa huli. Pati ang mga baka!$h

records.source: I'm pretty easy-going when it comes to movies... I like just about everything!
records.translation: Hindi ako mapili pagdating sa mga pelikula... Halos lahat ay gusto ko!

records.source: I had a great time, @! Thanks for thinking of me.
records.translation: Napakasaya ko, @! Salamat sa pag-alala sa akin.

records.source: Buh... Yeah, I guess this might be okay. *sniff* *sniff* ... a snack might help.
records.translation: Buh... Oo, baka ayos naman ito. *singhot* *singhot* ... Baka makatulong ang meryenda.

records.source: I'm rooting for the villain... *urp*
records.translation: Kakampi ako sa kontrabida... *dighay*

records.source: Okay, I'll admit... I thought it was pretty good.
records.translation: Sige, aaminin ko... Sa palagay ko ay maganda naman iyon.

records.source: Heh. I'm actually interested in seeing this one...
records.translation: Heh. Interesado talaga akong mapanood ito...

records.source: Okay, this is good...$h
records.translation: Okey, maganda ito...$h

records.source: Shane's trying not to smile.
records.translation: Pinipigilan ni Shane ang kaniyang ngiti.

records.source: When you're watching a good movie, you can forget about everything else... That's a gift.
records.translation: Kapag nanonood ka ng magandang pelikula, malilimutan mo ang lahat ng iba pa... Isang regalo iyon.

records.source: Buh... Yeah, I guess this might be okay. *sniff* *sniff* ... a snack might help.
records.translation: Buh... Oo, baka ayos naman ito. *singhot* *singhot* ... Baka makatulong ang meryenda.

records.source: Okay, I'll admit... I thought it was pretty good.
records.translation: Sige, aaminin ko... Sa palagay ko ay maganda naman iyon.

records.source: Ugh... this is going to be painful.
records.translation: Ugh... magiging masakit ito.

records.source: Shane's slumped over...
records.translation: Nakalugmok si Shane...

records.source: I feel depressed...$s
records.translation: Nalulumbay ako...$s

records.source: I'm really happy to see a movie!
records.translation: Masayang-masaya akong manood ng pelikula!

records.source: Jas is ecstatic!
records.translation: Tuwang-tuwa si Jas!

records.source: That was so much fun! Thanks for bringing me!$h
records.translation: Sobrang saya niyon! Salamat sa pagsama sa akin!$h

records.source: This is a grown-up movie, right? I'll be okay!
records.translation: Para sa matatanda ang pelikulang ito, hindi ba? Ayos lang ako!

records.source: Jas is nodding and glancing sideways.
records.translation: Tumatango si Jas habang sumusulyap sa gilid.

records.source: I thought it was good! It had... um... good 'die-a-log'! ...right?
records.translation: Sa palagay ko ay maganda iyon! Mayroon iyong... um... magandang 'diyalogaw'! ...hindi ba?

records.source: I... I'm not sure I'm allowed to see this...$s
records.translation: H... Hindi ko tiyak kung pinapayagan akong panoorin ito...$s

records.source: I'm scared...$s
records.translation: Natatakot ako...$s

records.source: Jas is trembling.
records.translation: Nanginginig si Jas.

records.source: *sniff*...$s
records.translation: *singhot*...$s

records.source: I've heard there's some really beautiful nature footage in this one... I'm really looking forward to it!$h
records.translation: Nabalitaan kong may napakagagandang kuha ng kalikasan dito... Sabik na sabik akong mapanood ito!$h
